text: 中国人民银行公布2026年10月金融数据。10月末，社会融资规模存量为469.16万亿元，同比增长7.2%；广义货币（M2）余额359.06万亿元，同比增长7.1%。两项指标均高于名义GDP增速，同经济增长、价格总水平预期目标相匹配。 东方金诚首席宏观分析师王青判断，年底前使用全面降息降准等总量型货币政策工具的可能性下降，监管部门将主要引导银行等金融机构加大对国民经济重点领域和薄弱环节的支持力度，推动“六张网”建设及“五篇大文章”领域贷款高增。（21财经）
text_en: The People's Bank of China released October 2026 financial data. At the end of October, the stock of social financing was 469.16 trillion yuan, up 7.2% year on year; the balance of broad money (M2) was 359.06 trillion yuan, up 7.1% year on year. Both indicators were higher than nominal GDP growth, matching the expected targets for economic growth and the general price level. Wang Qing, chief macro analyst at Golden Credit Rating, judged that the likelihood of using aggregate monetary policy tools such as across-the-board interest rate cuts and RRR cuts before the end of the year has declined, and that regulators will mainly guide banks and other financial institutions to increase support for key areas and weak links of the national economy, promoting the construction of the "Six Networks" and high growth in lending to the "Five Major Articles" areas. (21st Century Business Herald)
